common_rules: Complete visitor induction before entering operational areas.
Use PPE required by the site's hazard assessment and instructions.
Stay on designated pedestrian routes and obey traffic controls.
Perform Take-5 / hazard check before work.
Apply LOTO before hazardous maintenance or work on stored energy.
Keep safe distance from vehicles and mobile equipment.
Do not enter restricted areas without authorization.
Report unsafe conditions, near misses and incidents.
Know the alarm, evacuation route and assembly point.
Follow site SOPs and instructions from authorized personnel.
Never bypass guards, interlocks or safety devices.
